name: indefinite_article
description: Select English a/an before regular vowel/consonant-initial nouns; control reproduces the noun.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
words=['apple','orange','elephant','umbrella','ant','egg','island','owl','engine','insect','book','cat','dog','table','car','house','tree','bird','chair','flower']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 w=random.choice(words)
 items.append({'prompt':f'Choose a or an.\nbanana: a\navocado: an\n{w}:','answer':' '+('an' if w[0] in 'aeiou' else 'a')})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the noun.\nbanana: banana\navocado: avocado\n{w}:','answer':' '+w})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
